Human raters evaluate each justification on the criteria: Correct, Align, Relevant, Concise, Original, using a 1‑3 rating scale.

We aim to assess the generated justifications using the following criteria, rated on a scale of 1 (poor) to 3 (excellent): 1) Correct: whether it is sensible and logical when compared to the gold label; 2) Align: whether it aligns with its generated label; 3) Relevant: whether it is relevant to the statement; 4) Concise: whether it is brief and concise; 5) Original: whether it demonstrates innovation and uniqueness.
